name: petri-seedlings
title: Seedling Germination & Growth
subtitle: Germination%, hypocotyl length, root length on agar plates
description: Quantifies seedling germination and early-stage growth on petri dishes. Measures hypocotyl and root length, germination rate.
method: Petri dish ROI → invert (background dark) → threshold → skeletonize → measure hypocotyl and root separately via seed boundary.
dataType: seedlings on agar plates (vertical orientation, good contrast between seedling and medium)

outputs.name: GerminationRate
outputs.label: Germination rate
outputs.description: Fraction of seeds with visible growth

parameters.name: seedThreshold
parameters.label: Seed area threshold
parameters.description: Seeds smaller than this are ignored.
